items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: You know, Louis Cottrell's dad was a famous drummer.

ctx.x: I don't remember him. He might have been downtown more. Most likely I've seen him, but I mean, I don't remember.

No. And Cottrell, too. You know, Louis Cottrell's dad was a famous drummer. Probably worked most of the time downtown here. You might go ahead with your different shows now, because I know you played so many in some of the... Oh, yeah.
We had a gang of shows.
